name: harness
description: Claude Code plugins in two layers — the process every role shares (plan, dev, review, ship, lead, guards, bundled as harness) and role packs enabled per repo (frontend, backend, mobile, ai, workplace domain).

plugins.name: core
plugins.description: Session and project basics every role uses: verify-done evidence gate, project-init bootstrap, compact/compound memory, sync-memory, btw.

plugins.name: progress
plugins.description: Shows a skill's checklist when it starts and each checkpoint as it completes (✅ 3/6), then 🏁 when all are done. Never blocks.

plugins.name: plan
plugins.description: Design before code: brainstorming, grill, domain-model, codebase-design, writing-plans → PLAN.md.

plugins.name: review
plugins.description: Review a diff or PR: review-checklist, review-diff, blast-radius impact analysis, create-pr description.

plugins.name: dev
plugins.description: Build and fix, for every role: coordinator lane router, feature (dispatches slices to the role packs' engineers), ticket, fix-bug red loop, tdd, checkpoint gates.

plugins.name: frontend
plugins.description: Frontend role pack: the frontend-engineer agent, ui-feature, design-ui (Figma to UI), React and Next.js rules. Enabled per repo by core's repo-profile hook.

plugins.name: backend
plugins.description: Backend role pack: the backend-engineer agent, api-endpoint, db-change, api-client (third-party APIs), Python, FastAPI and Prisma rules. Enabled per repo by core's repo-profile hook.

plugins.name: ship
plugins.description: Land and release: finish-branch, ci-triage, release-checklist, write-migration.

plugins.name: mobile
plugins.description: Mobile role pack: the mobile-engineer agent, mobile-feature (React Native / Expo screens, platform states, simulator check), React Native rules. Enabled per repo by core's repo-profile hook.

plugins.name: ai
plugins.description: AI role pack: the ai-engineer agent and the agent-* skills for CopilotKit / AG-UI assistants on Mastra, LangChainJS or LangGraph — architecture from official reference repos, tools, HITL, graph, frontend, RAG, evals, security, turn verification — with their rules. Enabled per repo by core's repo-profile hook.

plugins.name: workplace
plugins.description: Domain pack for internal workplace / HR apps (time off, approvals, balances, room and meal bookings, maintenance requests): domain rules, starter model, kickoff questions and a domain review. Enabled per repo by core's repo-profile hook.

plugins.name: lead
plugins.description: Improve the process: weekly retro, session diagnosis, authoring skills.

plugins.name: guards
plugins.description: Personal guard-rail hooks: branch guard, commit gate, scope gate, blast-radius and session handoff. Opt-in.

plugins.name: harness
plugins.description: Everything: installs all nine role plugins.
